items.source: Defined in the core module in order to allow AnnotationAwareOrderComparator (and potential other candidates without spring-aop dependencies) to use it for introspection purposes, in particular annotation lookups.
items.translation: 在核心模块中定义，以便让 `AnnotationAwareOrderComparator`（以及潜在的其他不依赖 spring-aop 的候选类）将其用于内省目的，特别是注解查找。

items.source:
Note that this interface should just be implemented if the decorated class
is not within the hierarchy of the proxy class to begin with. In particular,
a "target-class" proxy such as a Spring AOP CGLIB proxy should not implement
it since any lookup on the target class can simply be performed on the proxy
class there anyway.
items.translation: 请注意，如果装饰的类本身就不在代理类的层次结构中，才应该实现此接口。特别是，像 Spring AOP CGLIB 代理这样的“目标类”代理不应实现它，因为无论如何都可以在代理类上直接执行对目标类的查找。

items.source:
In case of an AOP proxy, this will be the ultimate target class,
not just the immediate target (in case of multiple nested proxies).
items.translation: 在 AOP 代理的情况下，这将是最终目标类，而不仅仅是直接目标（在存在多个嵌套代理的情况下）。

items.source: Return the (ultimate) decorated class behind this proxy.
items.translation: 返回此代理背后的（最终的）装饰类。
